title: Attend Food: Flavors and Preferences
description: Prototype tastes, not verified source recipes. Nature flavors rank foods and control badges and reward hearts. Missing flavors/base liking remain neutral. Inventory counts stay at 1.

foods.*.testLiking.label: Temporary preview liking override
foods.*.testLiking.hint: Remove to restore nature/flavor scoring. Zero shows an empty test heart. Negative values show purple dislike bursts and refuse food; -1 adds angry expression.

foods.*.testDislike.label: Force dislike preview (including zero percent)
foods.*.testDislike.hint: Test-only: zero liking shows a grey irritation burst and quietly refuses food.

foods.*.flavors.*.label: Flavor strength
foods.*.flavors.*.hint: spicy / sour / sweet / dry / bitter. Favored flavor adds; disliked flavor subtracts.
